android-flyverify-integration 1.0.1

- Introduces an interactive, step-by-step workflow (5 steps) for integrating MobTech FlyVerify (SecVerify) into Android projects.
- Guides users on project path validation, configuration file creation and validation, Gradle environment setup, and privacy compliance per MobTech requirements.
- Supports dynamic inquiry and code generation for pre-verification and one-click login features.
- Offers detailed instructions for Gradle configuration based on AGP version.
- Provides privacy policy compliance guidance, with code injection into user-specified locations.
- Workflow proceeds with user confirmation at each step for maximum accuracy and compliance.
